rec.name: Collection Product Card Image Slider + Quick Add to Cart
rec.status: Built — merged to live theme (Nov 2025), iterated through Jan 2026

what.text: Product cards in the collection grid get two upgrades. (1) A swipeable image gallery on each card, with a thin progress bar under the image on mobile and no dots or arrows. This follows the LFDY reference, and the bar is meant to signal that more images exist. (2) A Quick Add to Cart (QATC) button, a cart-bag icon at the bottom-right of the image, that opens a size selector and adds to cart without leaving the grid. After adding, the cart drawer opens. The card also shows badges (NEW, BESTSELLER, AUSVERKAUFT), title and price. This record bundles two sections from a multi-section order, 'CRO | CP | Product Slider' and 'CRO | CP | Quick Add to Cart (Fashion)'. The ticket text only lists the order as linked subtasks, so the detail comes from the comments.

why.text: Showing more product images in the grid lets shoppers judge fit and look without a PDP visit, which reduces friction and sharpens their choice. A subtle bar under the image signals that more images exist without cluttering the card, which matters on mobile. QATC shortens the path to purchase for shoppers who already know what they want, and opening the cart drawer afterwards keeps momentum toward checkout.

how.text: 1) Add a product-card media slider to the collection grid. Enable swipe on mobile and hide dots and arrows. Render a thin (1px) indicator bar under the image, left-aligned on the first image like the LFDY reference. Show the bar only when a product has multiple images. Desktop hover can alternatively show the 2nd image. 2) Add a QATC button using the theme's default cart icon, so it matches the header cart icon. It opens a variant (size) selector with the same size and corner style as the PDP. The variant selector is left-aligned with the ATC button and the label text comes from theme content ('Size'). The article-specific hint in the popup is read from product.metafields.standard.size_guide_hint. After a successful add, trigger the sidebar cart drawer. 3) Make the QATC a theme-editor toggle; it was disabled on desktop (about 5% of users) and kept on mobile. Keep product images clickable through to the PDP.

items: Enable/disable Quick Add to Cart (toggle; off on desktop at client request)
Product image slider on/off, mobile swipe with thin indicator bar (no dots/arrows)
Slider bar thickness (changed 2px → 1px to match QATC icon stroke)
Optional alternative: show 2nd image on hover instead of slider (LFDY style)
Size label text via theme content (translatable)
Size-guide hint text via product metafield

dependencies.text: Focal theme (v8.11.4 in the screenshot). Metafield product.metafields.standard.size_guide_hint for the article-specific hint in the QATC popup. Custom JS from the 'CRO | CP | Quick Add to Cart (Fashion)' section, extended to open the cart drawer after ATC. Products need multiple images for the slider bar to appear. Known pitfalls reported by the client: cart upsells broke after the changes (language and image display), color swatches rendered empty on mobile, product images lost their link, and a hidden duplicate ATC button appeared when the toggle was enabled.

items: Quick Add to Cart usage rate and ATC rate from collection pages
Add-to-cart rate / conversion rate for collection-page sessions
Mobile bounce and scroll depth on collection pages

images.caption: Collection grid 'Unsere Neuheiten': product cards with badges, image slider (arrows/dots in this early version), bag icon for Quick Add bottom-right, plus title and price.
Client feedback: slider should have no dots and no arrows, only a subtle line under the product image on mobile, plus a small intro animation.
LFDY reference: product image with a thin dark progress bar at the bottom-left, with no dots or arrows.
